answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The umber holds work receipts rather than names, so the zenith of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the orchard of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
